title: Adopt protocol-processor main ed211803 (fifth pin adoption: GET_AVB_INFO wrong-type NOT_SUPPORTED)
body:
**Fifth parent pin adoption:** protocol-processor main **ed211803** (processor PR #201, #200: a GET_AVB_INFO on a descriptor other than AVB_INTERFACE answers NOT_SUPPORTED). FPGA-gPTP stays at 55680bff.

**Parent-visible change:** a wrong-type GET_AVB_INFO now answers status 11 (NOT_SUPPORTED, IEEE 1722.1-2021 Table 7-141), echoed at its own length. It previously answered 1 (NOT_IMPLEMENTED, since processor PR #182). The status is unchanged for an absent AVB_INTERFACE index (NO_SUCH_DESCRIPTOR) and for a command shorter than 16 octets (BAD_ARGUMENTS).

**Required:**
- Bump the protocol-processor gitlink to ed211803.
- Find every milan-fpga test, model or document that expects status 1 for this case, and update it to 11 citing the clause.
- Run every consumer gate that reads the processor: the full sweep, milan_dp, the firmware gate set, rtl-fast with `cd tests && behave`, Yosys, lint and the docs gates.
- Run route-1x1, ooc-1x1 and ooc-8x8 against the current resource record. The expected delta is about 0.
- Record the adoption in the submodule adoption table and the CHANGELOG.

Relates to processor #200 and to milan-fpga #773, #774 and #775, which are the other fixes for the next qualification image.
